subject: [hw] R1 -> lead: F1 (V14 HIGH) CBZ/CBNZ i=1 decode bug; V14 currently stops on ordinary branches
body: Posted to hw-v14 with repro and fix: emu/n2a32_t16.c:324 uses mask 0xF700 which requires the CBZ i bit (bit 9) to be 0, so cbz/cbnz with |offset| >= 64 (i=1) return UNDEF, and t16_misc_cbz does not add i<<6. Repro 0xB310 -> rc=1; expected target 0x1048. Census cbz=4429/cbnz=744. This affects the Thumb integration path now, not just a corner. Other V/T packages reviewed so far: V03/V10/V11/V12/V30 tests all pass on my run; deeper spot tests in progress.
